subject: How to add a line to a given plot of (grouped) points?

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: How to add a line to a given plot of (grouped) points?
parts:
Dear ggplot2-expeRts,

I would like to add a line to a given plot of points. The points are
colored
according to a grouping variable. The line is not directly related to
this grouping
so it should not be colored. The coordinates of the line are given in
a second data
frame. How can I add the line to the point plot without being forced
to give it
a grouping variable? Here is a minimal example:

require(ggplot2)

df1 <- data.frame(Time=2001:2010, Group=rep(c("Group1", "Group2",
"Group3"), each=10),
Value=rep(1:10, 3)+runif(30))
df2 <- data.frame(Time=c(2001, 2010), Value=range(df1$Value))

## Trial 1
ggplot(df1, aes(x=Time, y=Value, colour=Group)) + geom_point() +
geom_line(aes(x=Time, y=Value), data=df2)
## => error 'Group' not found

## Trial 2
ggplot(df1, aes(x=Time, y=Value, colour=Group)) + geom_point() +
geom_line(aes(x=Time, y=Value, colour="black"), data=df2)
## => now the line is "added" to the legend (how to avoid that?)

Cheers,

Marius

> "Group3"), each=10),
>                  Value=rep(1:10, 3)+runif(30))
> df2 <- data.frame(Time=c(2001, 2010), Value=range(df1$Value))
>
> ## Trial 1
> ggplot(df1, aes(x=Time, y=Value, colour=Group)) + geom_point() +
>    geom_line(aes(x=Time, y=Value), data=df2)
> ## => error 'Group' not found

> ## Trial 2
> ggplot(df1, aes(x=Time, y=Value, colour=Group)) + geom_point() +
>    geom_line(aes(x=Time, y=Value, colour="black"), data=df2)
> ## => now the line is "added" to the legend (how to avoid that?)
You can set the color to black by taking it out of the eas() call, like this:
ggplot(df1, aes(x=Time, y=Value, colour=Group)) + geom_point() +

geom_line(aes(x=Time, y=Value), colour="black", data=df2)

What I do is put only the common aesthetics in the main ggplot call,
and the rest in the geom calls, like this

ggplot(df1, aes(x=Time, y=Value)) + geom_point(aes(colour=Group)) +
geom_line(data=df2)

Best,
Ista

messages.subject: Re: How to add a line to a given plot of (grouped) points?
parts:
ggplot() + geom_point(data=df1, aes(x=Time, y=Value, colour=Group)) +
   geom_line(aes(x=Time, y=Value), data=df2)

If you're using two dataframes it's better to tell the geom_'s individually rather than leave it in the ggplot() call. 

The above seems to work for me, does it do what you want?

Brandon
